name: Café Amely
kurzbeschreibung:
**Café Amely in Riezlern**

Welcome to **Café Amely** in the charming village of **Riezlern**, nestled in the heart of the **Bregenzerwald** region of **Vorarlberg**. Just a short drive from **Dornbirn** and **Bludenz**, this cozy café invites you to savor the finest local flavors in a warm, rustic atmosphere.

Indulge in a freshly baked **Apfelstrudel** or a rich **Kaiserschmarrn**, paired with a creamy **Kaffee** or a frothy **Milchkaffee**. For those craving something heartier, their **Käsekrainer** or a classic **Wiener Schnitzel** will hit the spot.

The café’s sunny terrace offers a perfect view of the surrounding **Alpen**, making it an ideal spot for a leisurely breakfast or an afternoon break. Whether you're exploring the **Bregenzerwald**’s hiking trails or simply unwinding, **Café Amely** promises a taste of **Vorarlberg**’s hospitality.

Open daily—come by and experience the warmth of **Riezlern**!
